Discover the 2026 Toyota Camry LE, a stylish and efficient sedan that combines comfort, technology, and performance. With just over 12,180 miles, this used vehicle features an Ocean Gem exterior with a Light Gray interior, offering a sleek look. Powered by a 2.5-liter naturally aspirated four-cylinder engine producing 225 horsepower, it delivers impressive fuel economy with 52 mpg city and 49 mpg highway. The CVT automatic transmission and front-wheel drive provide smooth handling. This Camry is equipped with advanced driver-assist features like adaptive cruise control, blind spot monitor, lane keep assist, collision warning, cross traffic alert, and a backup camera to enhance safety and convenience. Its modern amenities include Apple CarPlay, Bluetooth, satellite radio readiness, a Wi-Fi hotspot, wireless phone charging, and an 8-inch touchscreen infotainment system for entertainment and connectivity. Seating for five and a spacious cabin make it ideal for families or commuters seeking a reliable, stylish ride packed with the latest technology.

This used Camry LE offers a practical yet safe driving experience. It includes essential safety features such as automatic emergency braking at intersections and junctions, rear junction crossing emergency braking, vehicle exit safety system, dual knee airbags, traffic sign recognition, regenerative braking, four-wheel ABS, emergency braking preparation, and anti-lockout power door locks. The rear seat reminder ensures passenger safety, while these systems work together to provide peace of mind on every trip. Designed for city streets and highway miles alike, this vehicle prioritizes safety without sacrificing comfort or tech features, making it a smart choice for those seeking dependability and modern convenience.

2026 Toyota Camry Safety and Security Features

This Camry’s safety package includes automatic emergency braking at intersections and junctions, helping to prevent collisions. It also features rear junction crossing automatic emergency braking, check rear seat reminder, vehicle exit safety system, dual knee airbags, traffic sign recognition to keep you aware of speed limits, regenerative braking for efficiency, four-wheel ABS for stopping power, emergency braking preparation, and anti-lockout power door locks. These features work together to ensure a secure driving experience in various conditions, giving drivers confidence and peace of mind on every trip.

2026 Toyota Camry Entertainment and Technology Features

The Camry LE boasts an 8-inch touchscreen infotainment system offering seamless access to radio, Bluetooth, and auxiliary input via USB. It supports voice-operated radio and hands-free phone calls, allowing safe control while driving. Compatibility with Toyota Connected Services enables smart device app integration, enhancing connectivity. The system includes HD radio for clear audio and six speakers for a quality sound experience. Electronic messaging assistance, with read and voice-activated functions, keeps you connected safely. Whether streaming music or managing messages, this tech package keeps you entertained and informed on every journey.

2026 Toyota Camry Performance Features

This Camry LE features auto start/stop technology that improves fuel efficiency by shutting down the engine when idling. Its electric motor is powered by a lithium-ion battery, providing smooth hybrid performance. These features balance power and economy, whether navigating city streets or highway miles. The result is a responsive, eco-friendly sedan that combines performance with savings, ideal for drivers seeking reliability and efficiency.

Our inspection process does not include disassembly of components or testing every mechanical, electrical, or fluid system within the vehicle. Certain components, systems, or fluids may not be inspected or may not show signs of potential failure at the time of inspection.

Due to the nature of pre-owned vehicles, normal wear, hidden conditions, or mechanical issues may exist or may develop after purchase, even if they were not detected during our inspection.
